preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 5*10**4 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::4]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of array a (n) is between 1 and 5*10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= m <= 10**9 for m in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::4]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the magic number m is between 2 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in map(int, lines[1].split())) for lines in [stdin.splitlines()[i:i+4] for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), 4)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, all elements in array a are between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 5*10**4 for k in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::4]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of array b (k) is between 1 and 5*10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in map(int, lines[3].split())) for lines in [stdin.splitlines()[i:i+4] for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), 4)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, all elements in array b are between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(map(int, lines[1].split())) + len(map(int, lines[3].split())) for lines in [stdin.splitlines()[i:i+4] for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), 4)]) <= 2*10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n and k over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value == 'Yes') == can_transform(a, m, b) for t, n, m, a, k, b in parse_input(stdin))
postconditions.description: The output is 'Yes' if it is possible to transform array a into array b using the allowed operations, otherwise 'No'.
